title: I don't like passkeys
summary: A critical opinion piece expressing the author's dissatisfaction with passkeys as a passwordless authentication solution, discussing potential usability, security, or practical concerns with this emerging WebAuthn/FIDO2 technology.
problem_solved: Provides critical perspective on whether passkeys truly solve user authentication problems or introduce new complications
why_valuable: Offers a balanced counter-perspective to mainstream enthusiasm for passkeys, helping developers and security professionals consider potential drawbacks before adoption
